LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony now serves House Telvanni. A Telvanni master has decided you might be useful, which is as close to a compliment as they get.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Enlist_Button_Desc: Serve a Telvanni wizard-lord. The work is strange, the pay is good, and nobody asks what happens in the towers.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Enlist_Requrements_No: No Telvanni master has any use for you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Enlisted_To_Hostile_F: House Telvanni does not employ its enemies, unless it is to experiment on them.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Menu_Missions_Desc: Errands from the Telvanni towers. They pay well and do not explain.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Provisions_Desc: Mushroom bread and potion ingredients from the tower.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in a Telvanni tower. Probably safe.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave House Telvanni? Your master may not even notice.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has left Telvanni service.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Resign_Button_Desc: End your service to the Telvanni.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The Telvanni masters have no further use for the colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Salary_Desc: Coin from a master who has already forgotten your name.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Work_0_Desc: Collect mushrooms, salts and stranger things for a Telvanni wizard.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseTelvanni_Work_1_Desc: Read books you are not supposed to understand.
